summary: Unilever PLC filed a Form 6-K furnishing a UK-style PDMR notification disclosing a routine open-market disposal by Business Group President, Foods Heiko Schipper, a member of the Unilever Leadership Executive. The filing states he sold 345 Unilever ordinary 3 1/2 pence shares (ISIN GB00BVZK7T90) on 2026-09-23 at EUR 54.79 per share on Euronext Amsterdam (XAMS), for total consideration of EUR 18,902.55. No board recommendation, advisor, stake, premium, or structural mechanics are given. This is an ordinary insider shareholding disclosure, not a special situation; watch only for further PDMR dealings.
